about_the_game:
The soviet megastructure suffered "The Fall", now you're left in the broken world of hunger and dangers. Play as Valentine as she scavenges apartments, trades goods with known settlements and fights endless anomalies.

EXPLORING AND ANOMALIES

Exploring the abandoned apartment complex is exhausting and confusing. It is filled with anomalies to the brim. Shadows of former tenants, space funnels ripping your skin and... mimics?

Most important danger of all - your body, bringing you challenges of constant thirst, hunger, panic and other conditions you need to monitor and worry about.

SCAVENGING AND MARAUDING

Grab everything you see to survive, but beware of dangers. Shattered glass, locked drawers, tick infestation, blinding darkness - that's the least you can expect from reaching your hands down the shelves.

You don't have a lot of time between the settlements and some of it is eaten by anomalies. Will you be cautious or quick with your scavenging?

TRADING AND DECEIVING

Trading is vital and will get you missing items, food, tools. It is a trouble trading trash and broken flashlights though. Use your merchant gambits and keen trader eyes to deceive people, spotting their fouls and making the best trade.

Are you ready to trade away your humanity though? Maybe eating canned beans today is better than eating full meal if it means someone will get a proper weapon for defense.

INTERACTIONS AND INVENTORY

Get full control of your belongings and items. The tactile inventory system shows you all the intricate actions you can do with each little item you see. Everything is manual: lighting up candles, writing down notes, cleaning your knife blade.

Manage your inventory and prepare your goods for trade. Maybe you should erase that expiry date on the canned stew you found to sell it for higher price.

DEMO VERSION

Demo version consists of separate prologue story, heavy on gameplay to show all the main features. It plays out in one go, though it is hard to complete on the first try! Get one of the two endings and try all of the main gameplay mechanics right now!

Full version will feature a 3 act story campaign with plot twists and mystery, more heavy on dialogue and choices.
